name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopian forces retook Rama in Tigray 7 Nov; shelling reported near Badme on the Eritrean border
state: Ethiopian federal forces reportedly retook Rama in Tigray after clashes on 7 Nov, and Eritrea reinforced positions around Badme, where clashes were reported on 9 Nov on an unconfirmed side of the border (Critical Threats, 10 Nov). EEPA reported on 12 Nov that Ethiopian forces shelled near Badme, and that an attack in Dalati, Benishangul-Gumuz, on 5–6 Nov killed over 65 people, including at least 27 civilians. No capital is under attack and no interstate war is confirmed.
for_you: UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Ethiopia and Eritrea, which advises against travel to Tigray and border areas. Exposure is mainly humanitarian, with displacement into neighbouring states.
rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in a conflict not tracked elsewhere (Watch): Tigray fighting, Badme border clashes; no interstate war confirmed (Alert line)
